description: Nine-panel composite combining EBSD phase mapping, correlative μ-DIC strain mapping and strain line-profiles. (a) is an EBSD phase map of the initial (0 % strain) microstructure with a white framed region of interest, an up-pointing "RD" arrow and a horizontal "Loading direction" arrow (loading parallel to RD), 50 µm scale bar; phase colours differentiate austenite (γ), δ-ferrite (δ) and TiB2. (b)-(f) are local von Mises equivalent strain maps from μ-DIC at applied macro strains of 3 %, 5 %, 7 %, 9 % and 15 % (labels top-right, each with a 20 µm scale bar); the shared vertical colour bar is "Von-Mises equivalent strain" running 0.00 to 0.20. Strain localises in multiregional bands rather than one concentration, intensifying progressively with applied strain. (g)-(i) are local equivalent strain (ε_eq) profiles across representative phase regions (arrows in the (a) inset); y-axis ε_eq = 0.00-0.24, x-axis Distance (µm) = 0-100 (g), 0-160 (h), 0-240 (i), with five curves per panel for 3 %, 5 %, 7 %, 9 % and 15 %. (g) brackets γ, δ and "Small TiB2" peaks; (h) spans "Large TiB2", "Small TiB2", γ and δ peaks; (i) covers "Sharp TiB2", δ, γ and "Sharp TiB2". Together the figure demonstrates progressive strain partitioning/localisation among austenite, δ-ferrite and TiB2 with rising deformation.

subfigures.description: EBSD phase map of the initial (0 % strain) microstructure showing austenite, δ-ferrite and TiB2 in distinct colours, with a white rectangular framed region of interest, RD (vertical) and horizontal 'Loading direction' arrows, and a 50 µm scale bar; the caption describes white, black and green arrows in the inset marking the profile lines used in (g)-(i).
Local von Mises equivalent strain map at 3 % macro strain; mostly dark blue (low strain) with isolated slightly higher-strain spots, 20 µm scale bar, label '3%'.
Local von Mises equivalent strain map at 5 % macro strain; faint strain bands begin to develop, 20 µm scale bar, label '5%'.
Local von Mises equivalent strain map at 7 % macro strain; connected strain-localised bands (green/cyan) become visible against blue matrix, 20 µm scale bar, label '7%'.
Local von Mises equivalent strain map at 9 % macro strain; stronger, higher-strain (yellow/red) bands appear, 20 µm scale bar, label '9%'.
Local von Mises equivalent strain map at 15 % macro strain; the highest strain intensities with many red bands along particle/matrix interfaces, 20 µm scale bar, label '15%'.

Line profile of local equivalent strain ε_eq (0.00-0.24) versus Distance (0-100 µm) with five curves (3 %, 5 %, 7 %, 9 %, 15 %); two γ-labelled shoulders at the ends and two δ peaks near ~35 and ~85 µm, separated by a 'Small TiB2' trough near 60 µm.

Line profile of ε_eq (0.00-0.24) versus Distance (0-160 µm) with five curves; labels 'Large TiB2' (near 10-20 µm), 'Small TiB2', a γ peak near 60-70 µm, a 'Small TiB2'/'γ' feature near 100-120 µm and a δ peak near 140 µm; the 15 % curve is highest.

Line profile of ε_eq (0.00-0.24) versus Distance (0-240 µm) with five curves; a sharp γ peak near 40 µm, minor δ, γ, δ features between ~80 and ~200 µm, and a strong δ/sharp TiB2 peak near 230 µm; the 15 % curve reaches highest values.

observations.observation: Panel (a) is an EBSD phase map of the undeformed (0 % strain) microstructure with a white framed region of interest, RD and 'Loading direction' arrows and a 50 µm scale bar.
Panels (b)-(f) are local von Mises equivalent strain maps labelled 3 %, 5 %, 7 %, 9 % and 15 % macro strain, each with a 20 µm scale bar.
The shared colour bar is labelled 'Von-Mises equivalent strain' and spans 0.00 to 0.20 with 0.02 intervals.
In panels (b)-(f) strain localises in multiregional bands rather than concentrating in a single area, and the fraction of green/red pixels grows monotonically from 3 % to 15 %.
Panels (g)-(i) share the y-axis 'Local equivalent strain (ε_eq)' over 0.00-0.24 and each contain five curves listed in the legend as 3 %, 5 %, 7 %, 9 % and 15 %.
The x-axis 'Distance' spans 0-100 µm in (g), 0-160 µm in (h) and 0-240 µm in (i).
Peak-height ranking is consistent across (g)-(i): the 15 % curve is highest and the 3 % curve lowest, so local equivalent strain increases with applied macro strain.
The caption states that strain-concentrated regions align at approximately 45° to the loading axis (Fig. 9(b-f)).
The citing text states that high strain (~10 %) is concentrated at the small TiB2/δ-ferrite interface in Fig. 9(g).
The citing text states that Fig. 9(h) shows elevated strain (~16 %) at austenite/TiB2 phase boundaries around micro-sized TiB2 particles.
The citing text states that strain concentrations (~20 %) occur near sharp TiB2/austenite and TiB2/ferrite boundaries at higher plastic deformation without cracking in Fig. 9(i).
The citing text states that local strain in the matrix adjacent to TiB2 particles (between the two dashed lines in Fig. 9(i)) exceeds that farther from the particles.

The citing text states that accumulated strain progressively exceeds that of δ-ferrite with increasing applied strain, reflecting higher local strain in the softer austenite due to austenite/δ-ferrite strain incompatibility.

The caption states the profiles in (g)-(i) were taken along arrows in the (a) inset: white = smaller TiB2/δ-ferrite matrix boundaries, black = matrix/TiB2 of various sizes, green = sharp TiB2/austenite and TiB2/δ-ferrite boundaries and austenite/δ-ferrite interfaces.

measured_quantities: von Mises equivalent strain (dimensionless, colour bar 0.00-0.20)
γ/δ/TiB2 phase volume fraction (from EBSD, statistically consistent with XRD)
unreadable_items: Panel (a): no explicit phase-colour legend is printed, so which colour denotes austenite, δ-ferrite and TiB2 must be inferred; the white, black and green arrows referenced by the caption are not reliably resolvable at the supplied resolution.
Panels (b)-(f): individual strain values cannot be read numerically from the colour maps (no pixel-level labels), only the shared colour bar range 0.00-0.20.
